incidents.what_happened: A tourist from Andhra Pradesh died after a gust of wind brought his glider down during take-off at Raison near Manali.
incidents.quote: Police said a sudden wind gust during take-off affected the glider's flight and, instead of going up, it went down.

incidents.what_happened: A 12-year-old girl suffered multiple fractures when a zipline cable broke mid-ride and she fell about 30 feet.
incidents.quote: She sustained multiple fractures in the fall and underwent surgery a few days later.

incidents.what_happened: A vehicle skidded off the road between Manali and Rohtang Pass, killing four people including two tourists from Punjab.
incidents.quote: Four people, including two tourists from Punjab, were killed on the spot

incidents.what_happened: A tourist vehicle fell into a gorge near Banjar in Kullu district, killing four tourists and seriously injuring 14.
incidents.quote: Four tourists died on the spot, police said.

incidents.what_happened: An SUV carrying tourists crashed near the north portal of the Atal Tunnel, killing a tourist from Rajasthan and injuring three.
incidents.quote: The deceased has been identified as Kailash (34), a resident of Sikar in Rajasthan.
